description: This file is a kernel initialization module for Zephyr RTOS, containing routines for system startup, memory setup, thread initialization, and hardware configuration.

methods.name: z_early_memset
methods.description: Weak implementation of memset for early boot, can be overridden per architecture.

methods.name: z_early_memcpy
methods.description: Weak implementation of memcpy for early boot, can be overridden per architecture.

methods.name: z_bss_zero
methods.description: Clears the BSS segment during early system initialization.

methods.name: z_bss_zero_boot
methods.description: Clears BSS within the boot section, used before paging is initialized.

methods.name: z_bss_zero_pinned
methods.description: Clears BSS within the pinned section, used before paging is initialized.

methods.name: z_sys_init_run_level
methods.description: Runs initialization functions for a specified system init level.

methods.name: bg_thread_main
methods.description: Main routine for the kernel background thread, completes kernel init and calls main().

methods.name: z_early_rand_get
methods.description: Generates early system randomness, optionally using hardware entropy.

methods.name: z_cstart
methods.description: Kernel startup routine, performs hardware and system initialization, then calls main().

methods.name: init_cpu_obj_core_list
methods.description: Initializes CPU object core list and stats.

methods.name: init_kernel_obj_core_list
methods.description: Initializes kernel object core list and stats.

methods.name: z_init_cpu
methods.description: Initializes CPU-specific data structures and threads.

methods.name: prepare_multithreading
methods.description: Initializes kernel data structures for multithreading and prepares main thread.

methods.name: switch_to_main_thread
methods.description: Switches context to the main thread, with architecture-specific handling.
